title: Revelation 144,000, Zion, Father-Name & New Jerusalem Cube Atlas
epistemic_rule: The biblical texts are primary sources in their own historical/theological contexts. Potatoverse mappings are later comparative readings and do not prove prophecy fulfillment, supernatural identity or numerical predestination.

core_cluster.revelation_7: 144,000 are sealed as servants of God, twelve thousand from each of twelve tribes; the vision then opens to a countless multitude from every nation, tribe, people and language.
core_cluster.revelation_14: The Lamb stands on Mount Zion with 144,000 who bear the Lamb's name and the Father's name on their foreheads; they are described as firstfruits and are followed by harvest imagery.
core_cluster.revelation_21: New Jerusalem descends from God; the city has twelve gates named for Israel's tribes, twelve foundations associated with the apostles, dimensions of 12,000 stadia, and a wall measured at 144 cubits.
core_cluster.mathematical_pattern: 144,000 = 12 × 12 × 1,000; 144 = 12 × 12. Revelation repeatedly links twelvefold numbering with covenant-community architecture rather than supplying a modern census key.
core_cluster.project_relevance: The unusually dense conjunction is not merely 144,000: Zion + Lamb/Son + Father's name + seal/forehead + twelvefold community + firstfruits/harvest + city/gates + 144/12,000 all belong to one Revelation architecture.

twelvefold_architecture.insight: The number system couples people, architecture and fruit. Community is presented as simultaneously counted, built and generative.
twelvefold_architecture.potatoverse_relation: Strong biblical neighbor for one-source/many-rooms, House, Gate, Tree, Fruit and New Jerusalem network imagery.

father_name_forehead.structure: seal/name on forehead → belonging/allegiance/identity → divine service/presence
father_name_forehead.contrast: Revelation contrasts divine sealing/name with the beast's mark/name/number in Revelation 13.
father_name_forehead.project_relation: Father-name, Eye/forehead, identity, inscription and belonging form a legitimate comparison cluster, but a modern person's name on an account/profile is not thereby fulfillment of Revelation.
father_name_forehead.epiphany: The forehead in Revelation functions as an identity/allegiance surface, not merely anatomical symbolism.

zion_144000_lamb.structure: Zion → royal/divine city-mountain → Lamb/king → gathered people → heavenly Jerusalem/city of living God
zion_144000_lamb.project_relation: Timic Mount Zion/North/New Jerusalem language gains depth when Zion is treated not simply as highest mountain but as royal-city, temple, assembly and covenant-political center.
zion_144000_lamb.important_difference: Revelation 14's Mount Zion is part of John's apocalypse; locating a modern Zion at the North Pole is a later project geography, not a biblical geographic claim.

new_jerusalem_cube.city_geometry: Revelation says length, width and height are equal at 12,000 stadia. A cube is the most immediate architectural reading, though the text states equal dimensions rather than explicitly naming a cube.
new_jerusalem_cube.holy_of_holies_parallel: Solomon's inner sanctuary / Most Holy Place is 20 × 20 × 20 cubits in 1 Kings 6:20. The cubic city therefore strongly evokes the innermost divine-presence chamber.
new_jerusalem_cube.temple_climax: Revelation 21:22 says there is no temple in the city because God and the Lamb are its temple.
new_jerusalem_cube.epiphany: A strong canonical reading is expansion of Holy-of-Holies presence from a restricted inner cube into the whole city: the innermost sanctuary becomes civic scale.
new_jerusalem_cube.potatoverse_relation: This is richer than 'heaven is a cube.' The biblical cube is better read as New Jerusalem / universalized sanctuary / divine-presence architecture. Cube therefore has both positive sanctuary and negative enclosure possibilities depending function.

cube_house_shell_correction.old_project_tension: Potatoverse often uses Cube/Saturn as enclosure while House/Garden is positive.
cube_house_shell_correction.biblical_complication: The Holy of Holies and likely New Jerusalem use cubic geometry positively.
cube_house_shell_correction.new_rule: Geometry alone cannot determine moral valence. A cube can mean sealed enclosure or concentrated holy presence; function, access, relation and what fills the space decide the reading.
cube_house_shell_correction.door_implication: New Jerusalem has walls yet twelve gates; Revelation 21:25 says the gates are never shut by day. Thus boundedness and openness coexist.
cube_house_shell_correction.project_epiphany: House vs Cube should not be shape-based. Healthy sacred enclosure = protected presence + legitimate/open passage + life inside; pathological shell = capture + blocked exit + extraction.

firstfruits_harvest.structure: firstfruits → representative beginning → larger harvest / completion
firstfruits_harvest.project_relation: Seed, Potato, first sprout, harvest, Farm/Garden and Son/Father succession can be compared at the level of sequence.
firstfruits_harvest.warning: Revelation's harvest includes judgment imagery; Garden/Farm vocabulary should not erase that severity.

sealed_number_vs_countless_multitude.observation: The numbered 144,000 are immediately followed by an innumerable multinational multitude.
sealed_number_vs_countless_multitude.interpretive_options: Christian interpreters disagree over whether these are two groups or two perspectives on one redeemed people; the archive should preserve that ambiguity.
sealed_number_vs_countless_multitude.project_reflection: Numbered remnant and unnumbered multitude create a useful tension between compressed Seed and expanded Tree: exact symbolic structure can open into unbounded plurality.
sealed_number_vs_countless_multitude.boundary: This is literary-structural comparison, not a claim that the Potatoverse identifies who the biblical 144,000 are.

zion_city_mountain_integration.structure: mountain + city + assembly + law/word + nations + divine presence
zion_city_mountain_integration.project_relation: Mountain, House, Throne, North, New Jerusalem and nations are biblically more coherent when treated as one civic-sacred complex rather than independent symbols.

new_jerusalem_as_descent.structure: seer is taken to high mountain → city descends from God
new_jerusalem_as_descent.project_epiphany: The biblical completion is not permanent escape upward. Vision ascends, sacred order descends. This strongly supports the mature Potatoverse ethic that ascent should return as House/Garden/City/repair in the world.

light_without_sun_moon.project_relation: Spudlight/source-light is conceptually deeper than literal physical Sun; the Lamb also functions as lamp in Revelation 21:23.
light_without_sun_moon.father_son_relation: God supplies glory/source; Lamb mediates lamp-like illumination. This offers a biblical source→mediator→city pattern without reducing either to astrophysics.

river_tree_throne.structure: Throne/Temple → river → Tree(s) → fruit → leaves/healing of nations
river_tree_throne.project_relation: Father/House/Throne → Spirit/flow → Tree → Fruit → healing/nations; one of the densest source-to-world sequences in the Bible.

high_value_project_questions: Is 144,000 better understood in the project as a completed twelvefold community pattern than as a literal headcount?
Does the repetition 144,000 → 144 cubits suggest that people and city are symbolically one architecture?
Does the Father's name on foreheads strengthen the project's Father/Eye/identity layer?
Does the Holy-of-Holies cube correct the project's tendency to treat every cube as Saturnian enclosure?
Does New Jerusalem show the final House as open-gated bounded order rather than boundarylessness?
Does the Zion→New Jerusalem sequence make Mountain simultaneously throne, city, assembly and revelation platform?
Does city-descending-from-heaven strengthen the principle that revelation completes in manifestation/service rather than escape?
